scenario: The ego vehicle performs a U-turn at an intersection while a pedestrian crosses the street.

ego.behavior: The car executes a U-turn at the intersection from the bottom lane.

adversarials.behavior: The pedestrian crosses the street from left to right in front of the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle starts at the bottom lane approaching a 4-way intersection, while the pedestrian approaches from the left side of the intersection, moving horizontally across the ego's path.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must complete the U-turn while avoiding collision with the crossing pedestrian; the scenario terminates once the ego has completed the U-turn or a collision occurs.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The blue car from first-person perspective is ego; the purple circle is adversarial pedestrian. 2. Enumeration: one Pedestrian adversarial. 3. Chronology: initial ego approaches intersection from bottom, pedestrian approaches from left; midpoint ego begins U-turn while pedestrian crosses; ending ego completes U-turn or interacts with pedestrian. 4. Evidence: ego's curved arrow shows U-turn trajectory; pedestrian's horizontal arrow shows left-to-right crossing path.
